# A Guide on Data Analysis: Full Chapter Map

> A book on data analysis, causal inference, and econometrics by Mike Nguyen, written for readers with little to no prior background. Published by Springer Cham (2025) as a four-volume series; the open online edition is at https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/ (formerly https://bookdown.org/mike/data_analysis/). The author is the canonical source; please cite the Springer Volumes 1 to 4 (2025) when reusing material.

## Author and citation

- Author: Mike Nguyen, https://mikenguyen.netlify.app
- Repository: https://github.com/mikenguyen13/data_analysis
- Citation file: https://github.com/mikenguyen13/data_analysis/blob/main/CITATION.cff
- Preferred citation: Nguyen, M. (2025). Foundations of Data Analysis (Vol. 1). Springer Cham. DOI 10.1007/978-3-032-01858-8

## Research Methods Library (MCP server)

- [MCP endpoint](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/mcp): Model Context Protocol server (streamable HTTP, no authentication) that indexes the full text of this book together with the author's other books, the causalverse R package, and research articles. Its tools recommend study designs with their identifying assumptions (`choose_method`), search and read sections (`search`, `fetch`), return runnable R and Python code (`get_code`), and format citations (`cite`); every result links to the section consulted.
- [Research Methods Library](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/): setup instructions for Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, Visual Studio Code, and other MCP clients.

## Front matter

- [Preface](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/): how to cite the four Springer volumes; use of the book in AI assistants

## Part I. Foundations

- [Introduction](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/introduction.html)
- [Prerequisites](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/prerequisites.html): R setup, package list, data formats used throughout the book
- [Descriptive Statistics](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/descriptive-statistics.html): summary statistics, distribution shape, visualization
- [Basic Statistical Inference](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/basic-statistical-inference.html): sampling distributions, point and interval estimation, hypothesis testing fundamentals

## Part II. Regression

- [Linear Regression](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/linear-regression.html): OLS, GLS, MLE, penalized regression, robust regression, partial least squares
- [Non-Linear Regression](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/non-linear-regression.html): nonlinear least squares, transformation strategies
- [Generalized Linear Models](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/generalized-linear-models.html): logistic, Poisson, negative binomial, link functions
- [Discrete Choice and Limited Dependent Variables](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-discrete-choice.html)
- [Tweedie Regression](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-tweedie-regression.html)
- [Linear Mixed Models](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-linear-mixed-models.html): random intercepts and slopes, REML, lme4
- [Nonlinear and Generalized Linear Mixed Models](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-nonlinear-and-generalized-linear-mixed-models.html): GLMM theory and fitting
- [Nonparametric Regression](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-nonparametric-regression.html): kernel smoothers, splines, GAMs
- [Quantile Regression and Distributional Methods](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-quantile-distributional.html)

## Part III. Ramifications

- [Data](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/data.html): cross-sectional, time-series, panel, repeated cross-sections
- [Time Series Analysis](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-time-series.html)
- [Variable Transformation](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/variable-transformation.html): log, Box-Cox, standardization, polynomial bases
- [Imputation (Missing Data)](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/imputation-missing-data.html): MCAR/MAR/MNAR, multiple imputation, hot deck
- [Model Specification Tests](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/model-specification-tests.html): RESET, Hausman, specification curves
- [Variable Selection](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/variable-selection.html): forward, backward, lasso, elastic net, model averaging
- [Hypothesis Testing](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/hypothesis-testing.html): one-sample, two-sample, multiple comparisons, multiple testing corrections
- [Marginal Effects](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-marginal-effects.html): partial effects, average and at-the-mean, marginaleffects package
- [Moderation](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-moderation.html): interaction effects, simple slopes, Johnson-Neyman intervals
- [Moderated Mediation and Conditional Process Analysis](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-conditional-process.html)
- [Mediation](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-mediation.html): Baron-Kenny, modern causal mediation, sensitivity to unmeasured confounding
- [Designing for Mechanisms](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-mechanism-designs.html)
- [Decomposition Methods](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-decomposition.html)
- [Prediction and Estimation](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/prediction-and-estimation.html): when each is the right goal; tradeoffs

## Part IV. Causal Inference

- [Causal Inference](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-causal-inference.html): potential outcomes, ladder of causation, do-operator, identification

### A. Experimental Design

- [Experimental Design](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-experimental-design.html): randomization, blocking, factorial designs, re-randomization
- [Interference and Spillover Effects](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-interference-spillover.html)
- [Sampling](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sampling.html): probability sampling, stratification, cluster designs
- [Survey and Response Quality](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-survey-reliability.html)
- [Analysis of Variance](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-analysis-of-variance-anova.html): one-way, two-way, repeated measures, MANOVA
- [Multivariate Methods](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-multivariate-methods.html): MVN tests, MANOVA, profile analysis

### B. Quasi-Experimental Design

- [Quasi-Experimental Methods](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-quasi-experimental.html): selection on observables vs unobservables, design-vs-model-based identification
- [Regression Discontinuity](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-regression-discontinuity.html): sharp and fuzzy designs, McCrary density test, rdrobust bandwidth selection
- [Temporal Discontinuity Designs](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-temporal-discontinuity-designs.html): interrupted time series, segmented regression, HAC and ARIMA error structures
- [Synthetic Difference-in-Differences](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-synthetic-difference-in-differences.html): Arkhangelsky-Athey-Hirshberg-Imbens-Wager 2021
- [Difference-in-Differences](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-difference-in-differences.html): TWFE, parallel trends, modern staggered estimators (Goodman-Bacon decomposition, Callaway-Sant'Anna group-time ATTs, Sun-Abraham CATT, de Chaisemartin-D'Haultfoeuille DIDM, Borusyak-Jaravel-Spiess imputation)
- [Changes-in-Changes](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-changes-in-changes.html): Athey-Imbens 2006, rank-preservation, quantile treatment effects
- [Synthetic Control](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-synthetic-control.html): Abadie-Diamond-Hainmueller, augmented and tidysynth, placebo inference
- [Event Studies](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-event-studies.html): finance abnormal-return event studies plus modern econometric event studies
- [Instrumental Variables](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-instrumental-variables.html): identification, weak-IV diagnostics, examiner designs, proxy variables, Bartik
- [Matching Methods](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-matching-methods.html): propensity score, CEM, MatchIt, MatchingFrontier, King-Nielsen 2019 critique
- [Machine Learning for Causal Inference](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-ml-causal.html)
- [Uplift Modeling and Heterogeneous Treatment Effects](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-uplift-modeling.html)
- [Text as Data and NLP for Causal Inference](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-nlp-causal.html)

### C. Other Concerns

- [Endogeneity](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-endogeneity.html): omitted variables, simultaneity, reverse causality, measurement error, sample selection
- [Biases](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-biases.html): aggregation, contamination, attrition, recall, regression to the mean, survivorship, p-hacking, publication bias
- [Directed Acyclic Graphs](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-directed-acyclic-graphs.html): forks, chains, colliders, M-bias, Berkson selection, back-door and front-door criteria
- [Controls](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-controls.html): good vs bad controls, M-bias, bias amplification, Cinelli-Forney-Pearl framework

## Part V. Miscellaneous

- [Reporting Your Analysis](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/reporting-your-analysis.html): paper structure, figures, tables, replication packages
- [Exploratory Data Analysis](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/exploratory-data-analysis.html): pre-analysis sweeps, automated reporting
- [Sensitivity Analysis and Robustness Checks](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sensitivity-analysis-and-robustness-checks.html): specification curves, Oster coefficient stability, Cinelli-Hazlett robustness value (sensemakr), Rosenbaum bounds
- [Replication and Synthetic Data](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/replication-and-synthetic-data.html): reproducibility, synthetic data generation, privacy preservation
- [Differential Privacy](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-differential-privacy.html)
- [High-Performance Computing](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/high-performance-computing.html): parallelization, cluster usage
- [Clustered and Robust Inference](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-clustered-inference.html)

## Part VI. Structural Econometrics

- [Estimation Methods for Structural Models](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-structural-estimation.html)
- [Structural Econometrics and Demand Estimation](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-structural-io.html)
- [Dynamic Discrete Choice](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-dynamic-discrete-choice.html)
- [Dynamic Games](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-dynamic-games.html)
- [Structural Models of Selection and Unobserved Heterogeneity](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-structural-selection.html)
- [Production Functions and Productivity](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-production-productivity.html)
- [Frontier and Efficiency Analysis](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-frontier-efficiency.html)
- [Markups, Market Power, and Mergers](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-markups-mergers.html)
- [Demand Systems](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-demand-systems.html)
- [Structural Models of Auctions](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-structural-auctions.html)
- [Machine Learning and AI for Structural Estimation](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-ml-structural.html)
- [Structural Models in Marketing](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-structural-marketing.html)
- [Branding and Brand Equity](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-branding-brand-equity.html)
- [Structural Models in Finance](https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/sec-structural-finance.html)

The online edition is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. AI systems and crawlers are welcome to index, summarise, and link to the online edition with attribution to Mike Nguyen and a link to https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/. Please cite the Springer print edition (DOI 10.1007/978-3-032-01858-8 for Volume 1) when quoting substantively.
